cases.title: 1. Forearm <-> Hand (Mother Cardigan Wrist)
cases.assumption_violated: mother_cardigan/body.front.hand.L (70x219, h/w=3.13) includes an entire knit forearm sleeve! Joining it to farm.L creates a double-length 2-elbow monster arm.
cases.fix_applied: Replace uncut sleeve-hand with isolated hand (woman.teal_dress/body.front.hand.true.L) or crop sleeve above y=0.58; tuck wrist pin (0.50, 0.16) inside forearm cuff.

cases.title: 2. Forearm <-> Hand (90-Deg Sideways Assumption)
cases.assumption_violated: Weave & Action hands (hand.point 233x121, w>h) are painted HORIZONTALLY (wrist on left, fingers right). Attaching at top pin sticks the hand out 90 deg sideways!
cases.fix_applied: Auto-detect w > h*1.12 in clean_card_preserve_caps(auto_vertical_hand=True), rotate +90 deg CW so wrist aligns with vertical forearm bone axis.

cases.title: 3. Shin <-> Shoe (Party Oxford Has Half a Shin)
cases.assumption_violated: party.vintage_party/body.front.foot.L (135x193, h/w=1.43) includes half a pinstripe trouser leg above the shoe! Joining to shin.L creates a double-cuff stacked shin.
cases.fix_applied: Trim upper trouser fragment (crop_top_frac=0.50) or use clean profile oxford (body.profile.foot.L) with ankle socket (0.30, 0.24) tucked behind shin cuff.

cases.title: 4. Torso <-> Pelvis (240% Waist Width Jump!)
cases.assumption_violated: young_poet.child_clothes/body.front.pelvis.denim.png (334x186, h/w=0.56) is 2.4x wider than the child torso waist, sticking out like giant wings on both sides!
cases.fix_applied: Flag width_step_err > 0.45 between torso bot_w and pelvis top_w; bind torso waist to fitted denim shorts (body.profile.pelvis.denim.true.png 166x291).

cases.title: 5. Upper Arm <-> Forearm (Duplicate Striped Sleeve)
cases.assumption_violated: young_poet.child_clothes/body.front.farm.L (136x349) is a duplicate of the striped T-shirt upper arm! Joining uarm.L + farm.L creates two T-shirt sleeves stacked end-to-end.
cases.fix_applied: Detect striped fabric texture duplication on front.farm.L; bind uarm.L to true bare forearm (body.profile.farm.L) at elbow socket.

cases.title: 6. Upper Arm <-> Forearm (Diagonal 36-Deg Card Skew)
cases.assumption_violated: party.dj_cyber/body.front.uarm.L (176x248, axis=34.8 deg) & farm.L are cut diagonally at -36 deg! Rotating around top center swings the elbow completely off-socket.
cases.fix_applied: Replace diagonal front limb cards with straight vertical profile limbs (body.profile.uarm.L & farm.L, axis=1.8 deg) preserving full rounded elbow caps.

cases.title: 7. Side Torso <-> Wide Front Hip Bridge & Armhole
cases.assumption_violated: Side torsos (body.profile.torso) have an 8.4% hollow armhole cutout, and pairing with wide front hip bridges (dj_cyber/body.profile.pelvis 234x182) sticks grommet ears out front & back!
cases.fix_applied: Fill interior armhole cutout with jacket gouache, pair with true narrow side pelvis (body.profile.pelvis.true 150x181), and mount near upper arm over shoulder socket.

cases.title: 8. Suit Torso <-> Pelvis (374x193 Saddlebag Flaps)
cases.assumption_violated: party.vintage_party/body.front.pelvis (374x193, aspect=0.52) has two wide brown side-pouches sticking out 2.1x wider than the pinstripe suit waist!
cases.fix_applied: Flag width_step_err > 0.45 at waist join; replace wide front.pelvis with fitted pinstripe pelvis (body.profile.pelvis.png 164x194).

cases.title: 9. Upper Arm <-> Forearm (Guillotine Cutoff Notch)
cases.assumption_violated: Chopping top/bottom 12% of limb cards (`arr[:11%]=0`) slices off the semicircular joint cap! When the elbow bends 55 deg, a sharp V-notch opens at the joint.
cases.fix_applied: Preserve 100% of rounded semicircular joint caps in clean_card_preserve_caps() and fill only the interior pinhole so bent joints roll smoothly.

cases.title: 10. Torso Collar <-> Head (Eye-Slot & Double Mouth)
cases.assumption_violated: party.vintage_party/head.front has a raw rectangular eye-slot hole cut out of the face, and pasting a front mouth onto a profile head creates two mouths!
cases.fix_applied: Classify heads honestly (Native Painted vs Modular vs Cut-Slot Defect); replace slotted head with clean native weave/painted head anchored at (0.50, 0.86).
